in_greek.name: Χαρλένη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χαρλένη προέρχεται από τη Γαλλική μορφή της λέξης Carol, που σημαίνει ελεύθερη, ανεξάρτητη. in_english.name: Charlene

Historically, the name Charlene gained popularity in the 20th century, reflecting its appeal across various Christian cultures.

The name Charlene, in turn, carries the same spiritual essence, encouraging its bearer to remember their inherent worth and ability to make choices that lead to a life of purpose and meaning.
